topics.description: Allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota have led to a federal investigation and a judge blocking the Trump administration from freezing $10 billion in child care funds. The investigation is ongoing, and the situation is being closely monitored.
topics.reason: Judge blocks Trump administration from freezing $10 billion in child care funds
